title: Why won't America stop building aircraft carriers?
fullText: in 2005 the US Navy towed one of its own aircraft carriers into the Atlantic and spent four weeks trying to sink it bombs torpedo charges  underwater blasts nothing worked in the end America had to press the button itself which raises the obvious question why won't America stop building aircraft carriers when the whole internet agrees they're obsolete and the sharper one what does the
